paragraphs.text: “Professor!” Norman’s alarmed voice drags you from sleep. “Look!”

Sylvia is no longer comatose. She squats on her blanket, her 
face hideously twisted.

Make a Hard POW roll for Sylvia: if she succeeds, go to 305; if she 
fails, go to 306.
